tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan lha mo ri phug ma dgyes pa'i bstod pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru dzña na de wi ye/ dpal ldan rgyal ba kun gyi yum mchog ma/ /dpal chen he ru ka dang mnyam sbyor ma/ /dpal gyi lha mo bkra shis bde ster ma/ /dpal mo ri phug ma la bstod par bgyi/ /khyod ni ye shes dag pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /chu skyes ze'u 'bru zla shel bzhad pa'i rtser/ /gdug can bam chen 'gyel ba'i khri steng du/ /dgyes shing rol pas 'gying la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang sku rab brjid dbang sngon gsar pa'i mdog /dmar zlum spyan gsum nyi zla'i gzi 'od 'bar/ /khro zhing bzhad pa'i zhal ni mche ba gtsigs/ /ljags dmar rab bskyod rdo rje'i sgra sgrog bstod/ /bung ba'i mdangs 'phrog ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ /rin chen nor bu'i rgyan 'phreng ji snyed dang / /sil sil sgra sgrog gser kha'i 'phyang phrul gyis/ /dpal mo'i sku mchog mdzes par byas la bstod/ /rab mdzes dar sngon na bza' sku la gsol/ /pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan stod g.yogs gos/ /lhab lhub rma bya'i sgro thul yid 'phrog pas/ /khyod sku kun nas mdzes par byas la bstod/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro yongs kyi dbus na 'gying / /ye shes dag pa'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs/ /ye shes lha mos rnal 'byor dbyings nas skyong / /da lta ri phug dpal gyi yang dben na/ /da med bstan 'dzin yongs kyi grogs mdzad ma/ /dal 'byor snying po len pa'i rnal 'byor bdag /da lta nas bzung byang chub bar du skyongs/ /res 'ga' smug nag sgeg mdzes khro mo'i gzugs/ /phyag g.yas mda' dar sna lnga g.yab cing 'dzin/ /phyag g.yon ne'u le sgrub la dngos grub stsol/ /dar gos rma bya'i sgro thul gsol la bstod/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro yongs kyi tshogs kyi gtso/ /las kyi ma mo yongs kyi rje mo che/ /dregs ldan lha srin yongs kyi sna 'dren ma/

/rnal 'byor dam can yongs kyi srung mar bstod/ /dkar dmar rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang / /chang phud bdud rtsi sman gyi gser skyems dang / /mda' dar spyan gzigs mdzes pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /ri phug lha mo 'khor bcas gsol zhing mchod/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng dhi paṃ ka ra dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston yab sras sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' dang dam tshig dgongs/ /bstan pa rin chen bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /dgyes zhing brtse bas lus dang grib ma ltar/ /'bral med 'grogs nas nyin mtshan kun tu skyongs/ /zhes dpal mo ri phug ma dgyes pa'i bstod pa 'di ni zhwa lu gser khang gi gdan sa bcu gsum pa rnal 'byor pa blo gsal gyis sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ dpal ldan lha mo ri phug ma dgyes pa'i bstod pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
